title: Absolute moment of a set indicator
statement: Let $A$ be a subset of the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube and let $r>0$. Under the uniform measure, the expectation of the $r$th power of the absolute value of its indicator is equal to the volume of $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite subset of the Boolean cube
replaced: For every $A\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$ and $r>0$, the uniform expectation satisfies $\mathbb E|\mathbf1_A|^r=|A|/2^n$.
